# Phase 57.1: Close gap: TENANT-01/02/03/04 — wire TenantGuard into Web UIs and admin-console-api views - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-07-06
**Status:** Ready for planning
**Mode:** Auto-generated (discuss skipped via workflow.skip_discuss)

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

Operator can enable `multi_tenant_enabled=True` and the admin-console-api views, admin-web-ui, and lawyer-web-chat all enforce tenant-scoped data access via `TenantGuard.enforce()` — no cross-tenant data leakage in Web UI read paths. Tenant context flows from RBAC token claims through admin-web-ui proxy to admin-console-api view handlers, and lawyer-web-chat session handlers apply tenant filters to message history and SSE streams.

This is a gap closure phase inserted after the v1.7 milestone audit found that Phase 56 built tenant isolation primitives (TenantScopeResolver, TenantGuard, TenantScopedContractLogStore, TenantNamespacedCache, Hindsight bank isolation) but Phase 57 Web UIs do not wire them into data access paths. The audit report is at `.planning/v1.7-MILESTONE-AUDIT.md`.

</domain>

## Implementation Decisions

### Claude's Discretion
All implementation choices are at Claude's discretion — discuss phase was skipped per user setting. Use ROADMAP phase goal, success criteria, and codebase conventions to guide decisions.

### Audit Findings (from v1.7 milestone audit)
- `services/admin-console-api/src/admin_console_api/views.py` — zero tenant references; TenantGuard.enforce() never called on list_conversations/list_tasks
- `services/admin-web-ui/src/admin_web_ui/server.py:143` — hardcodes `tenant_id="default"` instead of using identity.tenant_id from RBAC token
- `services/lawyer-web-chat/src/lawyer_web_chat/server.py:98` — extracts tenant_id from claims but only passes to session handlers, not applied as TenantGuard filter on message history/SSE stream
- `services/admin-web-ui/src/admin_web_ui/api_client.py` — AdminApiClient.proxy() does not pass tenant context to admin-console-api

### Key Constraints
- Must not modify frozen Protocol surfaces (BackendAdapter 9 methods, ChannelAdapter 6 methods, RouterPort.decide, SkillRegistryPort 3 read methods)
- `multi_tenant_enabled` must continue to default to `False`
- When disabled, behavior must be unchanged from current (no regression)
- Output boundary enforcement must be preserved
- All existing V2 gates must stay green
- `dependencies = []` invariant must be preserved for all affected packages

</decisions>
